dogecoin.text: I keep stacking up my dogecoin. Call me crazy, which is fair, but if shit goes wild I’ll be waving from my lunar vehicle, dressed like this 👨🏻‍🚀, doing 420 mph on the highway 🤷🏻‍♂️ 🐶
